title: Nadie llena el CRM de mi inmobiliaria (Serie Sala de Juntas, video 1)

ia.dice: ¡Asesores inmobiliarios! Nadie llena el CRM, nadie completa las notas. ¿Qué carajo pasó con mis leads?
ia.prompt: Vertical 9:16 video. Stylized 3D animated cartoon with exaggerated caricature proportions, like a modern animated comedy film, warm office lighting. Setting: a modern real estate agency meeting room with a glass wall, a long white table with laptops showing an empty CRM, coffee mugs and printed charts. At the head of the table stands Don Ramiro, a short chubby Mexican boss in his fifties with a thick black mustache, receding hairline, white shirt with rolled-up sleeves and a loose red tie. His face turns red with anger, he slams both fists on the table so the mugs jump, and shouts at his real estate agents in Mexican Spanish: "¡Asesores inmobiliarios! Nadie llena el CRM, nadie completa las notas. ¿Qué carajo pasó con mis leads?" Three real estate agents around the table flinch. Medium shot, slow push-in. Audio: only his angry voice in Spanish, fists on the table, mugs rattling. No music. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

ia.dice: Jefe, las notas de los leads las tengo… en mi cabeza. / Y yo lleno el CRM los viernes… cuando me acuerdo.
ia.prompt: Vertical 9:16 video. Stylized 3D animated cartoon with exaggerated caricature proportions, like a modern animated comedy film, warm office lighting. Setting: a modern real estate agency meeting room with a glass wall, a long white table with laptops showing an empty CRM, coffee mugs and printed charts. Diego, a skinny young real estate agent with glasses, slicked-back gelled hair and an oversized blue blazer, sweats nervously and taps his own forehead with one finger while saying in Mexican Spanish: "Jefe, las notas de los leads las tengo… en mi cabeza." Then Paola, a confident real estate agent with curly hair and a pink blouse, shrugs with a guilty smile and says: "Y yo lleno el CRM los viernes… cuando me acuerdo." Awkward silence, crickets chirping. Medium two-shot, static camera. Audio: their voices in Spanish, then crickets. No music. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

scenes.text: Si en tu inmobiliaria el CRM depende de que cada asesor lo llene, nunca vas a saber qué pasó con cada lead.
Con Lead Master, la IA lee los chats y escucha las llamadas de tus asesores, llena el CRM y escribe la nota de cada lead sola.
